items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: him and Chris stayed right close to each other

ctx.x: Ike. He's got his two legs off. Both of them off though? Yeah, both of them was off. I don't think we have. Well, him and I, him and Chris stayed right close to each other. I know that. Yeah. I know that. And I'm more sure he might know where I can get my hand on it. Well, between him and, between him and Parker there. What's that lady? Parker there. Where the Parker?

What's that lady name you mentioned a while ago with Wooden Joe? Lulu. Lulu Pascal. Lulu Pascal. Lulu Pascal. Lulu Pascal, my name. She's old time bro. I'mma see for it. I think she's still there. I'mma see for it. She's old time bro. They ought to keep all that, you know? Yeah, I'mma see. This used to be my boy.
